opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
This Court has recently in case of Mohd Siraj Saifi and 5 others Vs. State of U.P. and another,
2024:AHC:146047 has dealt with an order passed in above nature that though learned Magistrate has mentioned the position of law in regard to summoning under Section 204 Cr.P.C. in detail, but has not followed the same and summoned the applicants by way of an unreasoned order.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In present case, also the learned Magistrate has committed same error, accordingly, impugned order dated 27.01.2020 passed in Criminal Complaint Case No.3639 of 2019 (Smt. Dipika Vs. Hemant and others) under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station- Narsaina,
District- Bulandshahr pending before the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate does not survive and it is hereby set asideand matter is remitted back to learned Trial Court to pass fresh order after hearing the complainant only within three months.
Accordingly, applications are disposed of with aforesaid observation.
